scenario.topic: Decide where the choir should perform its winter concert

options.name: City Community Theater
options.upside: Offers a central location with professional sound support.
options.concern: Parking is limited during evening hours.

options.upside: Has high-quality acoustics and advanced audio equipment.

shared_context: The choir is planning its winter concert and must select a suitable venue that can accommodate 150 attendees, provide adequate acoustics, and be available on December 15th. The group consists of 4 decision-makers who will consider accessibility and technical support.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a choir director focused on professional presentation and sound quality.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the concert has excellent acoustics and technical support for a flawless performance.

A.reason_for: Good acoustics and on-site technician ensure professional sound support.

B.reason_for: Very good acoustics and advanced sound system support high-quality audio.
B.reason_against: Access restrictions may complicate attendee entry.

C.reason_for: Adequate capacity and easy accessibility with parking.
C.reason_against: Basic sound system may not meet technical needs.

D.reason_for: Free venue rental and quiet environment.
D.reason_against: Fair acoustics and no dedicated technician limit sound quality.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a choir member who values accessibility and convenience for attendees.
personas.private_goal: Make sure the venue is easy to reach and comfortable for the audience.

A.reason_for: Central location and professional sound support are positives.
A.reason_against: Limited parking could be a hassle for many attendees.

B.reason_against: University ID or guest pass requirement complicates access.

C.reason_for: Easily accessible with ample parking, ideal for attendees.

D.reason_against: Limited technical support and smaller stage area reduce suitability.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is an experienced event planner who prioritizes sound quality and technical sophistication.
personas.private_goal: Secure a venue with top-tier acoustics and advanced audio equipment.

A.reason_for: Good acoustics and on-site technician support quality sound.
A.reason_against: Parking limitations could affect audience experience.

B.reason_for: Very good acoustics and advanced sound system meet high technical standards.

C.reason_against: Basic sound system may not support complex audio needs.

D.reason_against: Fair acoustics and no dedicated technician limit sound quality.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a choir organizer focused on cost efficiency and community engagement.
personas.private_goal: Find a budget-friendly venue that fosters a welcoming atmosphere.

A.reason_against: Parking issues and possible higher costs.

B.reason_against: Access restrictions and possible higher fees reduce appeal.

C.reason_for: Accessible with ample parking and moderate capacity.
C.reason_against: Basic sound system may limit performance quality.

D.reason_for: Free venue rental and quiet setting support budget and community feel.

acceptance_reasons.C: Accessible with ample parking and moderate capacity.
